# EchoEyes: AI Vision Assistance for Blind & Low-Vision Users

# 👁️ See the World Through AI

EchoEyes is an AI-powered accessibility tool for blind and low-vision users.

With simple microgestures, understand surroundings, read text, detect danger, and navigate with spatial audio—hands-free and intuitive.

[media]


# 🎯 Key Features

**✋ Microgesture Controls**
No buttons—just tiny thumb motions to control everything one-handed.

**👂 Real-Time Environment Understanding**

Instant audio descriptions of people, objects, and details around you.
[media]

**🔤 Text Recognition**

Swipe to read signs, labels, screens, and documents instantly.
[media]


**⚠️ Danger Detection**

Immediate alerts when hazards are detected ahead or behind you.
[media]

**🦯 EchoRay: Virtual Guide Cane**

Turn your hand into a spatial audio guide cane. Through MR, EchoRay transforms surfaces into 3D sound—closer obstacles sound louder. Navigate by listening, like a white cane.
[media]

# ✋ How It Works
- **Scan surroundings** → Thumb Tap
- **Left / Right Swipe** → Read text
- **Detect danger** → Forward / Backward Swipe
- **EchoRay** → Pinch & Hold 3 sec

Raise thumb beside index finger, tap or slide. EchoRay: pinch and hold. Both hands work independently.

[media]
# 💎 Benefits

- Independence: Move confidently anywhere.
- Safety: Real-time hazard awareness.
- Spatial Awareness: Sense obstacles with 3D audio.

# 🌟 Perfect For

- Blind and low-vision users
- Those with gradual vision loss
- Anyone needing environmental awareness
